name: crabhud
description: A crab above the prompt that shows what Claude is doing, a progress bar for long jobs (it also appears on its own from Claude's task list or an approved plan), and a HUD with the model, effort, context, 5-hour and 7-day limits and cost, drawn in twelve bar styles. A live panel beside the chat follows the subagents. Includes the /crab-flow skill and its five worker agents.

language.title: Language
language.description: English by default. pt is Brazilian Portuguese, ru is Russian (the agents panel and the bar only), and auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system's.
